summary: Comprehensive testing of Cupim na Telha delivery management system. All 4 new features tested and working: 1) POST /api/backup returns valid ZIP with 5 files (1 xlsx + 4 pdfs), 2) All 7 tabs visible and clickable with good contrast (white/80% text on blue bg), 3) Backup tab has date picker and 'Gerar Backup' button, 4) Reports tab shows all 7 payment method cards with print buttons.
